title: Browser shows CORS error when API actually returned 401 on preflight or credentialed request
symptoms: Console CORS error on login API
cause: Browsers hide many error bodies when Access-Control-* headers are missing/mismatched; credentialed requests require explicit origin (not *) and correct Allow-Credentials.
solution: Configure API CORS for the real web origin, allow required headers/methods, and ensure preflight (OPTIONS) succeeds. Align cookie SameSite/secure settings with frontend origin.
workaround: Temporary local proxy in Vite/Next rewrites for development only.
